assets.visibleAssessment: The bifurcated organism remains one coherent volume across all four views. Both neck and head branches, the shared saddle torso, the two large negative-space arches, grounded limb stubs, pores, and head asymmetry survive. The opposite view proves the fork is volumetric anatomy rather than a front-view texture or silhouette trick.
limitations: The rear is simpler than the authored front and carries little explicit tail or dorsal anatomy.
The clay surface and circular pores remain visually close to the conditioning language.

assets.visibleAssessment: The side-view source resolves into a coherent squat crawler with a readable face, paired forelimbs, rear appendages, dorsal masses, and a complete back. The broad low body and lopsided front-to-rear mass survive, while much of the discrete bead rhythm is smoothed into one soft organism.
limitations: Segment separation is substantially weaker than in the source armature and source image.
The inferred rear becomes a broad undifferentiated body mass.

assets.visibleAssessment: Imagegen-added lobes, pores, head anatomy, and extra locomotor structure become stable 3D features. Trellis preserves visibly separated side and dorsal modules, builds a coherent multi-limb crawler, and closes the unseen rear without flattening the segmentation into paint. This is the richest cast of the pair and the clearest proof that model-prior invention can remain lineage-bearing through 3D reconstruction.
limitations: The face moves toward a familiar cute-creature prior.
The rear is coherent but less articulated than the source-facing side.

findings.fullRouteConclusion: Procedural SDF armatures can carry rare organism gestalt through conditioned image generation and into coherent textured Trellis casts. The route now supports both topology-preserving completion and bounded prior-led anatomical invention.

design.promotionRule: Promote cells that preserve the authored gestalt or produce a clearly lineage-bearing anatomical extrapolation; visual novelty without lineage remains insufficient.
design.trellisProbe: Promote a small discriminating subset through the same six-step 512 route so topology survival remains directly comparable.

lastTrustworthyEvidence: Three route-validated GLBs were rendered from four azimuths each and inspected against their selected imagegen sources at original resolution. All three are spatially coherent; fork preservation and bead prior-led invention are strong lineage hits.
